title: Surface area
description: Calculates the plan area of the farm pond from one-time length and breadth measurements.
methodology: Multiply pond length by breadth from the one-time survey. Result is surface area in m2 used by volumetric storage and related water-level calcs.

title: Increase in cumulative WL height
description: Sums all positive water-level rises across consecutive staff-gauge readings for a farm pond.
methodology: Order CM staff-gauge readings by date. For each consecutive pair (WL1 then WL2) add (WL2 - WL1) when the change is positive; ignore declines. The sum is the cumulative rise in water-column height (m).

title: Number of fillings
description: Estimates how many times the structure filled by dividing cumulative water-level rise by maximum pond depth.
methodology: Compute increase in cumulative WL height from the CM staff-gauge series. Divide by max depth of the structure (one-time height). Result is number of fillings over the monitoring period.

title: Volumetric storage
description: Estimates total water volume stored/harvested in the farm pond over the monitoring period (m3).
methodology: Compute surface area = length x breadth. Compute number of fillings from cumulative WL rise / max depth. Multiply surface area x height x number of fillings to get volumetric storage in m3.

title: Recharge
description: Estimates recharge from successive water-level declines after accounting for evaporation losses.
methodology: From consecutive staff-gauge readings sum declines that exceed evaporation E (cu.(WL2 - WL1 > E) style) then subtract cumulative evaporation. Evaporation E is an external/assumed input not currently captured in the survey sheet.

title: Volumetric savings KPI progress
description: Tracks progress (%) of realized volumetric storage against the farm-pond volumetric water savings KPI.
methodology: Compute volumetric storage as above. Divide by the one-time target KPI for the farm pond and express as a percentage.

title: Cumulative rainfall
description: Sums reported daily rainfall over the CM monitoring period for the farm pond asset.
methodology: Sum all CM rainfall (mm) readings for the selected asset over the analysis window. Used alongside water-level charts and filling analysis.

title: Water level in farm pond (individual)
description: Time-series visualization of farm-pond water level against daily and cumulative rainfall and the pond max height.
methodology: Plot CM staff-gauge water level over date on the primary axis. Overlay daily rainfall as bars and cumulative rainfall as a stepped line on a secondary axis. Draw a horizontal dashed line at one-time pond height as the WL upper limit.
chart_description: Dual-axis chart: dark-blue line with markers for water level (m); blue bars for daily rainfall (mm); light-green stepped line for cumulative rainfall (mm); grey dashed horizontal line for max pond height / WL upper limit.

title: SM difference (treatment vs control)
description: Average soil-moisture difference (%) between treatment and control observation points for bio-mulching / raised-bed plots.
variable_dependency: bm_cm_raised_bed_farming; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_centre; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_centre; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_centre
methodology: For flat plots use SM_diff (%) = average(SM_Tn - SM_Cn) across paired observation points. For raised beds compute ridge and furrow median diffs then average them: SM_diff = av(SM_r diff; SM_f diff). Control readings are paired by asset/date against treatment readings.

title: SM difference per unit area
description: Normalizes treatment-vs-control soil-moisture difference by treated plot area (per bigha or acre).
variable_dependency: bm_ot_area_under_the_crop; bm_ot_area_unit; bm_cm_raised_bed_farming; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_centre; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_centre; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_centre
methodology: Compute SM_diff (%) as above. Divide by treated plot area from the one-time survey (area under the crop) using the selected area unit (acre or bigha; 1 bigha ≈ 2529 m2 where applicable).

title: SM water savings
description: Converts soil-moisture difference into volumetric water retained in the root zone (m3) for bio-mulching / raised-bed treatment vs control.
variable_dependency: bm_ot_area_under_the_crop; bm_ot_area_unit; bm_cm_raised_bed_farming; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_centre; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_centre; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_centre
methodology: Compute SM_diff/bigha (or acre). Convert plot area to m2. Apply fixed root-zone depth of 40 cm. SM water savings (m3) = root zone depth (40 cm) x surface area (m2) x SM_diff/unit area (%).

title: Soil moisture treatment vs control
description: Line chart comparing soil moisture (%) over time for treated vs control bio-mulching / raised-bed plots.
variable_dependency: bm_cm_date_of_reading; bm_cm_raised_bed_farming; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_r_centre; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_raised_f_centre; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_a; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_b; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_c; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_corner_d; bm_cm_soil_moisture_flat_centre
methodology: Aggregate point readings into a plot-level soil-moisture series per date for treatment and for the paired control asset. Plot both series on soil moisture (%) vs date to show retention differences over the season.
chart_description: Dual-line chart: green line (T) for treated-plot soil moisture (%); blue line (C) for control-plot soil moisture (%); x-axis date; y-axis soil moisture 0–30%.

title: Irrigation water applied
description: Estimates irrigation volume applied to the PMDS plot from flow-meter readings or pumping hours times discharge rate.
methodology: If a flow meter is present sum CM volume readings (m3). Otherwise multiply pumping hours by the one-time pipe discharge (L/s) and convert to m3 (hours x L/s x 3.6).

title: PMDS cumulative rainfall
description: Sums rainfall recorded since the last irrigation over the CM monitoring period for the PMDS plot.
methodology: Sum all CM rainfall-since-last-irrigation (mm) readings for the selected farm plot.

title: PMDS volumetric savings KPI progress
description: Tracks progress (%) of soil-moisture water savings against the PMDS volumetric water savings KPI.
methodology: Compute SM water savings (m3) as above. Divide by the one-time PMDS volumetric savings KPI and express as a percentage.
